attractions.name: Swayambhunath Stupa (Monkey Temple)
attractions.description: Ancient Buddhist stupa atop hill at 2,365m with 360° views of Kathmandu. UNESCO World Heritage Site with colorful prayer flags, monkeys, and golden spire.

attractions.name: Pashupatinath Temple
attractions.description: Most sacred Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva on banks of Bagmati River. UNESCO World Heritage Site with cremation ghats and thousands of pilgrims.

attractions.name: Boudhanath Stupa
attractions.description: One of largest spherical stupas in world at 36m high. UNESCO World Heritage Site, center of Tibetan Buddhism with prayer wheels, monasteries, and Tibetan culture.

attractions.name: Kathmandu Durbar Square
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site with 800-year-old palace, 55-window palace, temples, and courtyards. Center of Newar architecture and royal history.

attractions.name: Garden of Dreams
attractions.description: Neo-classical garden at 2.5 acres in Thamel with 6 pavilions, fountains, seating areas, and peaceful escape from city chaos.

attractions.name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site with medieval architecture, Nyatapola Temple (5-story), 55-Window Palace, and traditional Newar culture.

attractions.name: Patan Durbar Square
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in Lalitpur with ancient palace, Krishna Mandir, Buddhist shrines, and finest Newar architecture.

attractions.name: Chandragiri Hill Cable Car
attractions.description: 2.8km cable car to 2,551m with panoramic views of Himalayas including Everest, Annapurna, and Langtang ranges on clear days.

attractions.name: Budhanilkantha Temple
attractions.description: Ancient Hindu temple with 5m long reclining statue of Lord Vishnu floating in water pond. Built in 7th century, sacred site for Hindus.

attractions.name: Dakshinkali Temple
attractions.description: Fierce goddess Kali temple near Pharping. Major pilgrimage site for animal sacrifices, especially on Tuesdays and Saturdays during festivals.

attractions.name: Narayanhiti Palace Museum
attractions.description: Former royal palace converted to museum in 2008. Shows royal artifacts, throne room, and modern Nepali history including monarchy end.

attractions.name: Kopan Monastery
attractions.description: Tibetan Buddhist monastery on hilltop with stunning valley views. Famous for meditation courses, peaceful setting, and Buddhist teachings.

attractions.name: Thamel
attractions.description: Bustling tourist hub with 500+ hotels, restaurants, shops selling trekking gear, souvenirs, clothing, and vibrant nightlife and entertainment.

attractions.name: Taudaha Lake
attractions.description: Sacred lake in Kirtipur with mythological importance. Beautiful natural setting, boating, bird watching, and peaceful environment.

attractions.name: National Museum of Nepal
attractions.description: Nepal's oldest museum with ancient art, sculptures, weapons, royal artifacts, and historical exhibits from Kathmandu Valley history.

attractions.name: Rani Pokhari
attractions.description: Historic pond built in 1667 by King Pratap Malla. Rectangular water body with temple in center, surrounded by walking path.

attractions.name: Akash Bhairav Temple
attractions.description: Historic temple in Kumari Ghat dedicated to Akash Bhairav. Known for people's wish fulfillment and unique architecture in Durbar Square.

attractions.name: Asan Bazar (Asan Tole)
attractions.description: Traditional market and Transit Point on ancient Salt Trade Route. Colorful spices, local products, and authentic Newari culture experience.

attractions.name: Guhyeshwari Temple
attractions.description: Sacred Shaktipeeth temple dedicated to Goddess Guhyeshwari near Boudhanath. One of most sacred Shakti Peethas in Hinduism.

attractions.name: Kathesimbhu Stupa
attractions.description: Ancient Buddhist stupa built in 1696, fourth largest in Kathmandu. Center of Old Kathmandu surrounded by prayer wheels and monasteries.

attractions.name: Indra Chowk
attractions.description: Bustling market square with Indra Mandir, Akash Bhairav, and traditional Newar architecture. Center of Rato Machindranath festival.

attractions.name: Kumari Bahal
attractions.description: Residence of Royal Kumari (living goddess) in Durbar Square. Traditional wooden architecture with intricately carved windows.

attractions.name: Phulchowki Hill
attractions.description: Highest hill in Kathmandu Valley at 2,762m with rhododendron forests, bird watching, hiking trails, and panoramic valley views.

attractions.name: Langtang National Park
attractions.description: Nepal's first Himalayan national park with snow leopards, red pandas, Langtang trekking, and breathtaking mountain scenery.

attractions.name: Everest Mountain Flight
attractions.description: 1-hour scenic flight from Tribhuvan Airport offering close-up views of Everest and 8,000m peaks. Unforgettable aerial experience.

attractions.name: Vajrayogini Temple
attractions.description: Sacred Buddhist temple near Swayambhu in Kirtipur. Important tantric pilgrimage site with stunning valley views.

attractions.name: Seto Machindranath Temple
attractions.description: White Machindranath temple in Janabahal. Important Buddhist temple dedicated to rain god, center of Rato Machindranath Jatra.

attractions.name: Tundikhel
attractions.description: Historic open ground since medieval times for military parades and public gatherings. Large grassy area in heart of Kathmandu.

attractions.name: White Monastery (Gompa)
attractions.description: Tibetan Buddhist monastery near Boudhanath with white walls, prayer wheels, and meditation halls. Peaceful retreat from city.

attractions.name: Kala Bhairav Temple
attractions.description: Black stone statue of Bhairav in Kathmandu Durbar Square. Ancient temple where people take oath for truthfulness.

attractions.name: Shiva-Parvati Temple
attractions.description: Temple in Kathmandu Durbar Square dedicated to Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. Traditional Newari architecture with intricate carvings.

attractions.name: Basantapur Tower (Dharahara)
attractions.description: 81m tall tower rebuilt after 2015 earthquake. Built in 1832 by Bhimsen Thapa, panoramic views of Kathmandu from top.

attractions.name: Kaiser Library
attractions.description: Historic library with 30,000+ books donated by Kaiser Shumsher. Located in elegant palace building with beautiful gardens.

attractions.name: Trishuli River Rafting
attractions.description: Thrilling white water rafting on Trishuli River, 2-3 hours from Kathmandu. Grade 3-4 rapids, jungle views, and camping opportunities.

attractions.name: Annapurna Temple
attractions.description: Temple dedicated to Goddess Annapurna in Durbar Square. Provides food for devotees, traditional Newari architecture.

attractions.name: Jagannath Temple
attractions.description: 17th-century temple in Durbar Square with erotic carvings similar to Khajuraho. Unique architecture and historical significance.

attractions.name: Stone Inscription (Ashoka Pillar)
attractions.description: 5th-century Emperor Ashoka's stone inscription in Bhaktapur. Historical evidence of ancient Nepal-India connections and Buddhist pilgrimage.

attractions.name: Cooking Class in Kathmandu
attractions.description: Learn to cook authentic Nepali dishes including momo, dal bhat, and sel roti. Hands-on experience with local ingredients and spices.

attractions.name: Royal Botanical Gardens
attractions.description: 40-hectare botanical garden in Godawari with native plants, orchids, ferns, and ecological trails. Beautiful natural setting.

attractions.name: Day Trip to Nagarkot
attractions.description: Mountain viewpoint at 2,195m with sunrise/sunset views of Himalayas including Everest, Langtang, and Annapurna ranges on clear days.

attractions.name: Phewa Lake
attractions.description: Pokhara's second-largest lake at 4.43 sq km with reflections of Machhapuchhre. Boating, lakeside cafes, and peaceful environment.

attractions.name: World Peace Pagoda
attractions.description: White Buddhist stupa on hilltop with 360° views of Annapurna range, Machhapuchhre, and Phewa Lake. Built by Japanese Buddhist monks.

attractions.name: Sarangkot
attractions.description: Famous viewpoint at 1,600m for sunrise/sunset views of Annapurna, Dhaulagiri, and Machhapuchhre. Popular paragliding launch site.

attractions.name: Mahendra Cave
attractions.description: Limestone cave at 200m long with underground river, stalactites, and stalagmites. Named after King Mahendra who visited in 1960s.

attractions.name: Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave
attractions.description: Sacred Shiva cave near Davis Falls with 18m waterfall, underground river, and religious shrines. Important pilgrimage site.

attractions.name: Davis Falls (Devi's Fall)
attractions.description: Unique waterfall that disappears underground near Mahendra Cave. Formed when Seti River changed course, water crashes into cave.

attractions.name: Mount Machhapuchhre Base Camp
attractions.description: Sacred base camp at 3,700m near fish-tailed Machhapuchhre (6,993m). Climbing prohibited due to religious significance, stunning views.

attractions.name: Sarangkot Paragliding
attractions.description: World's best paragliding site with tandem flights over Phewa Lake. 20-30 minute flights with mountain views and professional pilots.

attractions.name: Pokhara Valley Trekking
attractions.description: Various trekking routes from short walks to multi-day treks including Mardi Himal, Poon Hill, and Annapurna Base Camp treks.

attractions.name: Bindhyabasini Temple
attractions.description: Ancient temple dedicated to Goddess Bindhyabasini (Durga) in heart of Pokhara. Important pilgrimage site with daily rituals and offerings.

attractions.name: Tal Barahi Temple
attractions.description: Two-story pagoda temple on island in Phewa Lake. Only temple on lake island, accessible by boat, dedicated to Goddess Barahi.

attractions.name: Begnas Lake
attractions.description: Peaceful third-largest lake in Nepal, less crowded than Phewa. Beautiful sunrise views, fishing, boating, and lakeside resorts.

attractions.name: Rupa Lake
attractions.description: Third-largest lake in Pokhara Valley connected to Begnas. Beautiful natural setting, bird watching, and peaceful environment.

attractions.name: Pokhara Mountain Biking
attractions.description: Mountain biking trails from easy to challenging including trails to Sarangkot, Valley views, villages, and mountain scenery.

attractions.name: Pokhara Zipline
attractions.description: World's longest zipline at 1,800m, 150m/s speed. Thrilling adrenaline rush with mountain views and professional safety equipment.

attractions.name: International Mountain Museum
attractions.description: Museum dedicated to Himalayan mountaineering history with Everest artifacts, Sherpa culture, climbing equipment, and mountain photography.

attractions.name: Pokhara Bird Watching
attractions.description: Bird watching in Phewa Lake and surrounding areas with 250+ bird species including migratory birds, herons, kingfishers, and eagles.

attractions.name: Pumdi Bhumdi Statue
attractions.description: Statue honoring Sir Pumdi Bhumdi, renowned Nepali mountaineer and first Asian to climb Mount Everest without oxygen.

attractions.name: Pokhara Ski Resort
attractions.description: India's first indoor ski resort with artificial snow, ski slopes, snow park, and winter activities regardless of weather conditions.

attractions.name: Ghorepani Poon Hill Trek
attractions.description: Popular 4-day trek from Pokhara to Poon Hill viewpoint with sunrise views of Annapurna, Dhaulagiri, and Machhapuchhre peaks.

attractions.name: Pokhara Old Bazaar
attractions.description: Traditional old bazaar with local markets, authentic Pokhara culture, traditional shops, local food, and away from tourist crowds.

attractions.name: Seti River Gorge
attractions.description: Deep limestone gorge carved by Seti River beneath Pokhara city. White water visible from viewpoints, dramatic geological formation.

attractions.name: Pokhara Bungee Jumping
attractions.description: 110m bungee jump over Seti Gorge with professional safety equipment. Adrenaline rush with mountain views, Nepal's highest bungee.

attractions.name: Pokhara Ultralight Flight
attractions.description: 30-minute scenic flight over Annapurna range with close-up views of Machhapuchhre, Annapurna South, and Himalayan peaks.

attractions.name: Mardi Himal Base Camp
attractions.description: Less crowded trekking destination at 4,500m with close-up views of Mardi Himal, Machhapuchhre, and Annapurna South from Pokhara.

attractions.name: Pokhara Rafting
attractions.description: White water rafting on Seti and Marsyangdi rivers with Grade 3-4 rapids, jungle views, and camping opportunities from Pokhara.

attractions.name: Annapurna Clouds Restaurant
attractions.description: Popular restaurant with mountain views, international cuisine, rooftop dining, and sunset views over Phewa Lake and Annapurna range.

attractions.name: Pokhara Lakeview Terrace
attractions.description: Scenic terrace with panoramic views of Phewa Lake, mountains, and sunset. Popular spot for coffee, relaxation, and photography.

attractions.name: Pokhara Night Market
attractions.description: Evening market in Lakeside with street food, local products, souvenirs, handicrafts, and vibrant local atmosphere.

attractions.name: Shuklaphanta Garden
attractions.description: Peaceful garden in Pokhara with tropical plants, walking paths, and relaxation area. Perfect for early morning walks and meditation.

attractions.name: Pokhara Golf Course
attractions.description: 18-hole golf course with mountain views, professional equipment rental, and beautiful setting. First golf course in Gandaki Province.

attractions.name: Pokhara Rock Climbing
attractions.description: Rock climbing and rappelling on limestone cliffs near Pokhara with professional guides, equipment, and various difficulty levels.

attractions.name: Pokhara Waterfall Tour
attractions.description: Tour to multiple waterfalls including Davis Falls, Himalayan Waterfall, and Silver Cave with beautiful natural scenery.

attractions.name: Pokhara Yoga Retreat
attractions.description: Yoga and meditation retreats by Phewa Lake with certified instructors, mountain views, and peaceful natural environment.

attractions.name: Pokhara Museum of Art
attractions.description: Contemporary art museum featuring Nepali artists, Thangka paintings, traditional art, and cultural exhibitions.

attractions.name: Pokhara Cooking Class
attractions.description: Learn to cook authentic Nepali and Pokhara dishes including momo, dal bhat, and local fish. Hands-on experience with local ingredients.

attractions.name: Pokhara Sunrise Point
attractions.description: Early morning viewpoint at Sarangkot for sunrise over Annapurna range, Machhapuchhre, and Phewa Lake with golden mountain views.

attractions.name: Pokhara Zip Flyer
attractions.description: Same as Pokhara Zipline - world's longest zipline at 1,800m, 150m/s speed with mountain views and professional safety equipment.

attractions.name: Pokhara Buddha Temple
attractions.description: Peaceful Buddhist temple with Buddha statue, prayer wheels, meditation hall, and tranquil environment for contemplation and prayer.

attractions.name: Pokhara Valley Viewpoint
attractions.description: Panoramic viewpoint overlooking entire Pokhara Valley, Phewa Lake, and Annapurna range with sunset and sunrise opportunities.

attractions.name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site with well-preserved medieval architecture, 55-Window Palace, and temples.

attractions.name: Nyatapola Temple
attractions.description: Tallest pagoda-style temple in Nepal at 30 meters with five stories and intricate wood carvings.

attractions.name: 55-Window Palace
attractions.description: Royal palace famous for its ornate 55 wooden windows with intricate carvings from Malla period.

attractions.name: Pottery Square
attractions.description: Traditional pottery-making area where artisans demonstrate age-old techniques and sell handmade ceramics.

attractions.name: National Art Gallery
attractions.description: Museum housing exquisite Hindu and Buddhist sculptures, paintings, and royal artifacts from Malla period.

attractions.name: Bhaktapur National Museum
attractions.description: Museum showcasing history, art, and culture of Bhaktapur kingdom with royal artifacts.

attractions.name: Changu Narayan Temple
attractions.description: Oldest Hindu temple in Nepal dedicated to Lord Vishnu, UNESCO site with ancient stone carvings.

attractions.name: Taumadhi Square
attractions.description: Historic square featuring Nyatapola Temple and traditional Newari architecture.

attractions.name: Dattatreya Square
attractions.description: Ancient square with Dattatreya Temple and traditional wooden struts with mythological carvings.

attractions.name: Bhaktapur
attractions.description: Local market area famous for Newari cuisine including jhol momo, yomri, and traditional beer.

attractions.name: Siddha Pokhari
attractions.description: Historic rectangular pond built in 14th century, central to Bhaktapur's urban landscape.

attractions.name: Bhaktapur Wood Carving School
attractions.description: Traditional wood carving workshop where artisans demonstrate intricate Newari woodworking techniques.

attractions.name: Maya Devi Temple
attractions.description: Birthplace of Lord Buddha, featuring the sacred garden, birth marker, and ancient ruins revered worldwide.

attractions.name: Lumbini Sacred Garden
attractions.description: Peaceful garden with the sacred pond where Queen Maya Devi bathed before giving birth to Buddha.

attractions.name: Lumbini Museum
attractions.description: Museum showcasing Buddha's life, history of Lumbini, and Buddhist artifacts from around the world.

attractions.name: Monastic Zone
attractions.description: Area with monasteries from various countries, each showcasing unique Buddhist architecture and culture.

attractions.name: Ashoka Pillar
attractions.description: Ancient stone pillar erected by Emperor Ashoka in 249 BCE, marking his visit to Buddha's birthplace.

attractions.name: World Peace Pagoda (Lumbini)
attractions.description: White Buddhist stupa offering peaceful meditation space and views of the sacred birthplace area.

attractions.name: Chinese Monastery
attractions.description: Beautiful Chinese-style monastery with traditional architecture and peaceful gardens.

attractions.name: Japanese Monastery
attractions.description: Serene Japanese monastery featuring traditional Zen architecture and meditation gardens.

attractions.name: Theravada Monastery
attractions.description: Traditional Theravada Buddhist monastery with meditation halls and peaceful surroundings.

attractions.name: Marker Stone
attractions.description: Sacred stone marking the exact birthplace of Siddhartha Gautama Buddha in 623 BCE.

attractions.name: Sacred Pond (Pushkarini)
attractions.description: Holy pond where Queen Maya Devi bathed before giving birth to Buddha, still used for pilgrimage rituals.

attractions.name: Chitwan National Park
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site and premier wildlife destination for tiger, rhino, and elephant sightings.

attractions.name: Elephant Breeding Center
attractions.description: Center dedicated to elephant conservation and breeding, offering close encounters with elephants.

attractions.name: Narayani River Rafting
attractions.description: White-water rafting on the rapids of Narayani River with scenic jungle views and wildlife spotting.

attractions.name: Tharu Cultural Museum
attractions.description: Museum showcasing the culture, lifestyle, and traditions of the indigenous Tharu people.

attractions.name: Jungle Safari (Jeep)
attractions.description: Jeep safari through deep jungle offering chances to see tigers, rhinos, deer, and diverse bird species.

attractions.name: Canoe Ride
attractions.description: Traditional canoe ride along protected river areas to observe crocodiles and aquatic birds.

attractions.name: Paraguiding Chitwan
attractions.description: Paragliding over the tropical jungles of Chitwan with views of the Himalayas in the distance.

attractions.name: Tribeni
attractions.description: Scenic confluence of three rivers (Rapti, Reu, and Kali Gandaki) with peaceful natural beauty.

attractions.name: Bishazari Tal
attractions.description: Twenty thousand lake - a vast wetland area rich in biodiversity and home to numerous bird species.

attractions.name: Elephant Bathing
attractions.description: Interactive experience bathing elephants in the river, learning about elephant care and conservation.

attractions.name: Tharu Village Tour
attractions.description: Cultural tour of traditional Tharu village to learn about indigenous customs, dance, and lifestyle.

attractions.name: Patan Durbar Square
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for exquisite Newari architecture, ancient temples, and the Patan Museum.

attractions.name: Krishna Mandir
attractions.description: Stone Shikara-style temple dedicated to Lord Krishna, built in 1637 with intricate carvings.

attractions.name: Bhimsen Temple
attractions.description: Historic temple dedicated to Bhimsen, one of the Pandava brothers, located in the heart of Patan Durbar Square.

attractions.name: Golden Temple (Hiranya Varna Mahavihar)
attractions.description: Magnificent Buddhist monastery well-known for artistic carvings, metal works, and peaceful environment.

attractions.name: Mahaboudha Temple
attractions.description: Terracotta temple with thousand images of Buddha, built in Shikhara style inspired by Pandit temple in Boudha.

attractions.name: Taleju Temple
attractions.description: Ancient temple dedicated to Taleju, the royal goddess of the Malla kings, within Durbar Square.

attractions.name: Patan Museum
attractions.description: One of Asia's finest museums showcasing traditional Nepalese art, sculptures, bronze, and religious artifacts.

attractions.name: Kumbheswor Temple
attractions.description: 5th-century Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, famous for two sacred ponds and annual chariot festival.

attractions.name: Bungamati
attractions.description: Traditional Newari village south of Patan, known as winter residence of Lord Rato Machindranath.

attractions.name: Kopan Monastery (Patan)
attractions.description: Peaceful Buddhist monastery offering meditation sessions with beautiful mountain views.

attractions.name: Jawalakhel Temple
attractions.description: Famous for Tibetan community and famous Rato Machindranath Jatra chariot festival.

attractions.name: Namche Bazaar
attractions.description: Colorful Sherpa alpine town built into a mountain amphitheater at 3,440m, the main staging point for Everest expeditions with vibrant Saturday market.

attractions.name: Everest Base Camp (EBC)
attractions.description: Legendary camping ground at 5,364m at the foot of Mount Everest, the ultimate destination for trekkers seeking the world's highest peak experience.

attractions.name: Kala Patthar
attractions.description: Famous trekking viewpoint at 5,644m offering the best unobstructed panoramic sunrise view of Mt. Everest and surrounding Himalayan peaks.

attractions.name: Gokyo Lakes
attractions.description: Series of six spectacular high-altitude turquoise glacial lakes at 4,700-5,000m, sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists with stunning mountain views.

attractions.name: Tengboche Monastery
attractions.description: Leading Buddhist monastery of the Sherpa community at 3,867m, backdropped by Mt. Ama Dablam, Everest, and Lhotse with daily prayer ceremonies.

attractions.name: Lukla Airport
attractions.description: Dramatic hillside airport at 2,850m with 52% gradient runway, the thrilling gateway to Everest region known as Tenzing-Hillary Airport.

attractions.name: Sagarmatha National Park
attractions.description: UNESCO Natural World Heritage Site containing Mount Everest, Lhotse, Cho Oyu, and rare wildlife including snow leopard, red panda, and Himalayan tahr.

attractions.name: Khumjung Village
attractions.description: Largest village in Khumbu at 3,790m, foot of sacred peak Khumbila, home to Hillary School and reputed to house a Yeti scalp in the monastery.

attractions.name: Khunde Village
attractions.description: Traditional Sherpa village at 3,840m with Khunde Hospital maintained by Himalayan Trust and stunning views of Ama Dablam.

attractions.name: Gokyo Ri
attractions.description: 5,357m peak offering breathtaking 360-degree views of Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, and Cho Oyu, with Gokyo Lakes below.

attractions.name: Dingboche Village
attractions.description: Traditional agricultural village at 4,410m in Imja Valley, important acclimatization stop with stone-walled fields and mountain views.

attractions.name: Chhukung
attractions.description: High-altitude village at 4,730m, gateway to Chhukung Ri and Ama Dablam base camp, surrounded by towering peaks.

attractions.name: Poon Hill (Ghorepani)
attractions.description: One of Asia's most famous sunrise viewpoints at 3,210m with panoramic views of Annapurna South, Dhaulagiri, Machhapuchhre, and Hiunchuli.

attractions.name: Annapurna Base Camp (ABC)
attractions.description: Natural mountain amphitheater at 4,130m surrounded by massive ringed peaks including Annapurna I, Machhapuchhre, and Hiunchuli.

attractions.name: Ghandruk Village
attractions.description: Beautiful traditional Gurung ethnic village at 2,012m with stone-paved paths, traditional architecture, and stunning Annapurna views.

attractions.name: Machhapuchhre Base Camp
attractions.description: Sacred base camp at 3,700m near the iconic fish-tailed Machhapuchhre peak, prohibiting climbing due to religious significance.

attractions.name: Mardi Himal Base Camp
attractions.description: Less crowded trekking destination at 4,500m with close-up views of Mardi Himal, Machhapuchhre, and Annapurna South.

attractions.name: Tanahun by Nayapul
attractions.description: Primary starting point at 1,070m for Poon Hill and Annapurna Base Camp treks, gateway to the Annapurna foothills.

attractions.name: Birethanti
attractions.description: Scenic village at 1,060m where Modi Khola and Seti Khola rivers meet, popular starting point for short treks.

attractions.name: Dhampus Village
attractions.description: Picturesque village at 1,650m with stunning views of Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre, overnight stop on trek to Poon Hill.

attractions.name: Annapurna Sanctuary
attractions.description: Natural amphitheater surrounded by 40+ peaks above 6,000m, including five 7,000m and two 8,000m peaks, accessible via ABC trek.

attractions.name: Tilicho Lake
attractions.description: One of the highest altitude lakes in the world at 4,919m with turquoise waters, reached via Annapurna Circuit through challenging terrain.

attractions.name: Braga Village
attractions.description: Beautiful Himalayan town at 3,450m with 500-year-old Braga Monastery, ancient manuscripts, and traditional Tibetan architecture.

attractions.name: Gangapurna Lake
attractions.description: Glacial lake at 3,540m near Manang village, perfect for day hiking and acclimatization with reflections of Annapurna II and III.

attractions.name: Manang Village
attractions.description: Traditional village at 3,540m, important acclimatization stop on Annapurna Circuit with stone houses and Buddhist chortens.

attractions.name: Ice Lake (Kicho Tal)
attractions.description: Himalayan freshwater lake at 4,620m in isolated Manang valley, challenging full-day hike with spectacular mountain views.

attractions.name: Milarepa Cave
attractions.description: Sacred meditation cave where Tibetan yogi Milarepa meditated in 11th century, accessible via Braga village.

attractions.name: Praken Monastery (100 Lama Cave)
attractions.description: Regarded as good-luck cave monastery at 3,800m, historically sheltered 100 lamas during harsh winters.

attractions.name: Green Lake
attractions.description: Himalayan lake at 4,600m near Upper Pisang, beautiful trekking destination free from crowds with stunning glacier views.

attractions.name: Chongkor Viewpoint
attractions.description: Viewpoint at 3,900m above Gangapurna Lake offering breathtaking views of Gangapurna Glacier, Annapurna, and Tilicho peaks.

attractions.name: Sabje Lake (Cindi)
attractions.description: Uncrowded jewel in Manang region, perfect destination to skip crowded routes and meditate in pristine nature.

attractions.name: Tilicho Base Camp
attractions.description: Base camp at 4,900m for climbing Tilicho Peak and accessing Tilicho Lake, surrounded by towering Himalayan peaks.

attractions.name: Chame
attractions.description: District capital of Manang at 2,670m, gateway to Upper Manang and Annapurna Circuit starting point with local markets.

attractions.name: Pisang Village
attractions.description: Traditional village at 3,200m with Upper and Lower settlements, important acclimatization stop with stunning Annapurna views.

attractions.name: Upper Pisang
attractions.description: Upper settlement at 3,300m with traditional Manang architecture and panoramic views of Annapurna II and Chulu peaks.

attractions.name: Nar Phu Valley
attractions.description: Remote restricted valley at 4,000m with ancient Tibetan culture, beautiful villages, and pristine high-altitude landscapes.

attractions.name: Khangar Village
attractions.description: Traditional Manang village at 3,300m with ancient houses, Buddhist shrines, and spectacular mountain views.

attractions.name: Gyanrung Café Kali Gandaki Viewpoint
attractions.description: Scenic viewpoint in Chame offering stunning views of Annapurna II and the Kali Gandaki valley below.

attractions.name: Thorong La Pass
attractions.description: Highest pass on Annapurna Circuit at 5,416m, challenging crossing between Manang and Mustang with breathtaking Himalayan views.

attractions.name: Annapurna Circuit Trek Trail
attractions.description: One of the world's most famous trekking routes circling the Annapurna massif, passing through diverse landscapes and cultures.

attractions.name: Yak Kharka
attractions.description: High-altitude grazing area at 3,300m where yaks and dzos graze, important stop on Annapurna Circuit trek.

attractions.name: Jagat Village
attractions.description: Traditional village at 1,410m on banks of Marsyangdi River, starting point for Annapurna Circuit trek from lower elevation.

attractions.name: Narayan Village
attractions.description: Traditional village at 1,700m with stone houses and Buddhist stupas on the Marsyangdi River valley.

attractions.name: Lo Manthang
attractions.description: Walled city at 3,840m, former capital of Kingdom of Lo with 15th-century Royal Palace, ancient monasteries, and Tibetan Buddhist traditions.

attractions.name: Muktinath Temple
attractions.description: Most important pilgrimage site at 3,800m sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists, featuring 18 water springs and eternal flame.

attractions.name: Jomsom
attractions.description: District headquarters at 2,720m, gateway to Upper Mustang with airport, famous for apple farming and Thakali culture.

attractions.name: Kagbeni
attractions.description: Ancient village at 2,810m, entrance to Upper Mustang with old monastery, red buildings, and wind-swept landscape.

attractions.name: Tsharang Village
attractions.description: Historic village at 3,700m with old palace, chhortents, and monasteries from former Kingdom of Lo.

attractions.name: Dhakmar Clay Hills
attractions.description: Spectacular red cliff with Buddhist mantras carved into the rock face, dramatic landscape of Upper Mustang.

attractions.name: Chhoser
attractions.description: Village with unique sky caves, monasteries, grand rock formations, and Cora La viewpoint for Himalayan panoramas.

attractions.name: Luri Gompa (Luri Cave Monastery)
attractions.description: Ancient cave monastery at 3,700m related to different Buddhist sects, spectacular cliffside location with meditation caves.

attractions.name: Ghar Gompa
attractions.description: Ancient monastery with 600-year-old wall paintings, one of the oldest in Mustang with rare Buddhist artifacts.

attractions.name: Damodar Kunda
attractions.description: Holy lake at 4,900m sacred to Hindus and Vaishnavites, origin of Kali Gandaki River and source of Saligram stones.

attractions.name: Marpha
attractions.description: Apple farming village at 2,680m famous for apple brandy, pies, dried apples, and traditional stone houses with white walls.

attractions.name: Thini Village
attractions.description: Traditional village near Marpha with Buddhist monastery, apple orchards, and Thakali cultural heritage.

attractions.name: Chusang Village
attractions.description: Small settlement on Upper Mustang trekking route between Tangbe and Chele, ancient village with handprint caves.

attractions.name: Tangbe Village
attractions.description: Traditional village at 2,340m with old monastery, apple orchards, and white-washed houses along Kali Gandaki River.

attractions.name: Chele Village
attractions.description: Remote village at 3,050m on Upper Mustang trek, traditional architecture with yak herding culture and mountain views.

attractions.name: Royal Palace of Lo Manthang
attractions.description: 15th-century royal palace in walled city, former residence of Mustang kings with traditional Tibetan architecture and artifacts.

attractions.name: Jampa Lhakhang Monastery
attractions.description: 15th-century monastery in Lo Manthang, one of three major monasteries with ancient Buddhist paintings and sculptures.

attractions.name: Thubchen Gompa
attractions.description: Great monastery in Lo Manthang with stunning 600-year-old wall paintings depicting Buddhist cosmology and mythology.

attractions.name: Kali Gandaki Gorge
attractions.description: World's deepest gorge between Dhaulagiri and Annapurna, origin of Kali Gandaki River with Saligram stones.

attractions.name: Yak Kharka (Mustang)
attractions.description: High-altitude yak grazing area near Lo Manthang with traditional nomadic culture and stunning desert-like landscape.

attractions.name: Muktinath Valley
attractions.description: Sacred valley surrounding Muktinath Temple with natural springs, Buddhist and Hindu sacred sites, and panoramic mountain views.

attractions.name: Upper Mustang Trek Trail
attractions.description: Fascinating restricted area trek through former Kingdom of Lo with unique Tibetan culture, ancient monasteries, and desert landscape.

attractions.name: Janaki Mandir (Janaki Temple)
attractions.description: Magnificent temple dedicated to Goddess Sita, built in 1910 by Queen Vrisha Bhanu of Tikamgarh. Stunning neo-classical architecture with white marble, gold plating, and intricate Mithila paintings.

attractions.name: Ram Sita Vivaha Mandap (Bibaha Mandap)
attractions.description: Sacred pagoda-style structure marking the exact spot where Lord Ram and Sita got married. Adorned with beautiful sculptures, significant pilgrimage site from Ramayana.

attractions.name: Ram Mandir
attractions.description: One of the oldest temples in Janakpur, built by Gorkha General Amar Singh Thapa in 1782. Dedicated to Lord Rama, especially crowded during Ram Navami festival.

attractions.name: Gangasagar Pond
attractions.description: Holy pond in Janakpur located near Ram Mandir. One of 115 sacred ponds with mythological importance. Devotees take holy bath during Chhath and other festivals.

attractions.name: Dhanush Sagar Pond
attractions.description: Sacred pond located near Ram Mandir. Devotees take holy bath especially during Chhath festival. Associated with Hindu mythology and Ramayana.

attractions.name: Ratna Sagar Pond
attractions.description: Serene pond surrounded by temples, one of the four sacred ponds of Janakpur. Tranquil environment for meditation and relaxation away from city hustle.

attractions.name: Dhanushadham (Dhanush Mandir)
attractions.description: Located 15 km from Janakpur, important pilgrimage site. Believed that fragment of Lord Shiva's bow broken by Rama to win Sita is buried here alongside temple.

attractions.name: Swargadwari Temple
attractions.description: Located west side of Gangasagar pond. Important religious site where devotees perform rituals for their ancestors. Sacred place in Janakpur.

attractions.name: Parshuram Kunda
attractions.description: One of 115 ancient ponds of historical and mythological importance in Janakpurdham. Held extremely sacred by devotees, associated with sage Parshuram.

attractions.name: Rama Mandir & Dhanush Sagar Complex
attractions.description: Combined pilgrimage site featuring Ram Mandir temple and sacred Dhanush Sagar pond. Major attraction for devotees visiting Janakpur dham.

attractions.name: Nagar Nag Temple
attractions.description: Traditional temple dedicated to serpent gods. Part of Janakpur's rich religious heritage with ancient Mithila architecture and cultural significance.

attractions.name: Mithila Art Museum
attractions.description: Museum showcasing traditional Mithila paintings and art forms. Celebrates Janakpur's reputation as birthplace of Mithila art with vibrant colors and intricate patterns.

attractions.name: Women Development Center
attractions.description: Center promoting Mithila art and women empowerment. Tourists can purchase authentic Mithila paintings directly from local women artists.

attractions.name: Janakpur Railway Station
attractions.description: Historic narrow-gauge railway station connecting Janakpur to Nepal's railway network. Colonial-era architecture and historical significance from early 20th century.

attractions.name: Kamala River
attractions.description: Sacred river flowing near Janakpur. Important for daily rituals and religious ceremonies. Scenic riverside walks and traditional boat rides available.

attractions.name: Bharat Baasal
attractions.description: Traditional storage structure and historical site in Janakpur. One of the ancient water bodies mentioned in local mythology and religious texts.

attractions.name: Sitamarhi Temple Complex
attractions.description: Temple complex dedicated to Goddess Sita with multiple shrines and sacred ponds. Important pilgrimage destination for devotees of Lord Ram and Sita.

attractions.name: Hanuman Temple
attractions.description: Traditional Hanuman temple near Janaki Mandir. Many devotees visit after Janaki Temple to seek blessings from Lord Hanuman, Rama's devotee.

attractions.name: Shiva Temple (Kailashnath Mahadev)
attractions.description: Dedicated to Lord Shiva, located in central Janakpur. Traditional stone temple with daily aarti and religious ceremonies throughout the year.

attractions.name: Janakpur Garden of Dreams
attractions.description: Peaceful garden in Janakpur perfect for relaxation. Beautiful landscaped gardens, walking paths, and peaceful environment for families and tourists.

attractions.name: Manakamana Temple
attractions.description: Famous Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Bhagwati at 1,302m. Accessible by cable car with panoramic views of Himalayas, hills, and valleys. Popular pilgrimage site especially during Dashain and Navratri.

attractions.name: Sirubari Village
attractions.description: First tourism village in Nepal at 1,690m, famous for Gurung culture, stone-paved paths, traditional houses, and homestays. Panoramic views of Dhaulagiri, Annapurna, and Machhapuchhre.

attractions.name: Chhangchhangdi Temple
attractions.description: Ancient temple dedicated to Goddess Chhaya Chhetra at 1,800m. Important pilgrimage site with spectacular views of Annapurna and surrounding landscapes. Popular during Dashain festival.

attractions.name: Panchase Hill
attractions.description: Sacred hill at 2,280m with 360° views of Annapurna, Dhaulagiri, and Machhapuchhre. Ancient Buddhist and Hindu pilgrimage site with rhododendron forests, monastery, and sunrise/sunset views.

attractions.name: Ramkot Homestay & Village
attractions.description: Beautiful village at 1,500m with homestay experience. Panoramic views of Manaslu, Dhaulagiri, Annapurna, and Lamjung peaks. Traditional Gurung culture and warm hospitality.

attractions.name: Sworek Hill Paragliding Spot
attractions.description: Adventure spot for paragliding, cycling, and pilgrimage at 1,900m. Famous for adventurous activities with spectacular views of Aadhi Khola basin and surrounding mountains.

attractions.name: Bear Hill
attractions.description: Small hill station connected by Siddhartha Highway at 1,000m. Famous picnic spot with unique riverside views, perfect for sunset watching and photography.

attractions.name: Sundar Chaur Vegetation Information Center
attractions.description: Vegetation and biodiversity center showcasing diverse flora of Syangja. Educational site for nature lovers with trails through native plants and forest ecosystems.

attractions.name: Aandikhola Rafting
attractions.description: White water rafting on Aadhi Khola River with Grade 3-4 rapids. Thrilling adventure through scenic gorges, jungle views, and camping opportunities in Syangja.

attractions.name: Kaple Bhairavi Temple
attractions.description: Ancient temple dedicated to Goddess Bhairavi in Syangja hills at 1,400m. Important local pilgrimage site with beautiful mountain views and traditional architecture.

attractions.name: Gorkha Durbar (Palace)
attractions.description: Historic palace complex at 1,130m, birthplace of Gorkha Kingdom and unification of Nepal by Prithvi Narayan Shah in 18th century. UNESCO potential site with intricate architecture and royal artifacts.

attractions.name: Gorkha Nath Temple (Gurkha Memorial Museum)
attractions.description: Temple dedicated to Guru Gorakhnath within Gorkha Durbar. Museum showcasing Gorkha military history, weapons, uniforms, and contributions of Gurkha soldiers to British and Indian armies.

attractions.name: Mount Manaslu Base Camp
attractions.description: Base camp for world's 8th highest peak at 8,163m. Remote trekking destination with breathtaking mountain views, traditional villages, and pristine Himalayan wilderness.

attractions.name: Laprak Village
attractions.description: Traditional Gurung village in Manaslu region at 2,100m. Authentic cultural experience with traditional architecture, terraced farms, and warm hospitality away from tourist crowds.

attractions.name: Sama Village & Hot Springs
attractions.description: Remote village near Manaslu with natural hot springs at 1,900m. Healing waters, traditional Gurung culture, mountain views, and peaceful environment for relaxation.

attractions.name: Tibetan Refugee Camp (Ghyangtse)
attractions.description: Tibetan refugee settlement near Gorkha with traditional monasteries, prayer flags, handicrafts, and Tibetan culture. Buy authentic Tibetan handicrafts and support local community.

attractions.name: Bhirkot Durbar
attractions.description: Historic palace in Bhirkot town at 915m, important site in Gorkha Kingdom unification. Ancient architecture and historical significance from 17th-18th century Gorkha history.

attractions.name: Manaslu Circuit Trek
attractions.description: World's most spectacular trek circling Mount Manaslu through Larkya La Pass (5,106m). Restricted area permit required, pristine nature, traditional villages, and breathtaking Himalayan views.

attractions.name: Gorkha Museum (Prithvi Narayan Shah Memorial)
attractions.description: Museum dedicated to King Prithvi Narayan Shah and unification of Nepal. Royal artifacts, weapons, historical documents, and exhibits about Gorkha Kingdom history.

attractions.name: Tsum Valley
attractions.description: Remote Himalayan valley in Manaslu region with ancient Buddhist monasteries, traditional villages, and pristine wilderness. Sacred Tibetan Buddhist culture with 400+ year old gompa.
